item.title: [IGNITE-8476] AssertionError exception occurs when trying to remove node from baseline under loading
item.description:
Run 6 nodes, start loading (8 threads, 1000 2x cache.get() and 2x cache.put() in each thread per second)

Kill 2 nodes and try to remove one node from baseline using

control.sh --baseline remove node1
control.sh --baseline version TOPOLOGY_VERSION

commit a70cfc938de4433aa8dbf488d9d87c37dd7a4f55
Author: Ivan Rakov <irakov@...>
Date: 2018-05-18T09:47:28Z

IGNITE-8476 added covering test

I can't reproduce the issue so far. I've prepared a pull request with test that covers described scenario. Test stably passes.
Test contains cases with replicated/partitioned, atomic/tx caches, cross-cache transactions. There are no any AssertionErrors in log and loader threads don't hang.
qvad, please provide more precise conditions to reproduce the bug. If possible, please fix test in PR if it misses something.

ivan.glukos I've got same AssertionError while adding node from baseline with clean LFS.

  1. Start cluster, activate, start client with loading
  2. Kill single node, clean LFS and start it again
  3. AssertionError

Next steps in this case:

  1. Add new single node in cluster
  2. Add new node to baseline
  3. Wait for transaction loading ends
  4. LRTs in client logs and transactional loading hangs (transactions with timeout=5 ms)

Another test scenario with no transactional loading:

  1. Start cluster, load data
  2. Start client
  3. Create transactional cache
  4. Start long transactions (transactions with infinite sleep() and interrupt variable to call commit() on it)
  5. Add new node in cluster that is not in baseline
  6. Release transactions after some minor timeout
  7. Try to get values from cluster that was affected by this long transactions

First 3 cache.get() are successful, next get() hangs and throw Assertion in server logs
